name: Thorn Strike 1

name: Disengage 1

name: Elemental Sight 1

name: Fading Shot 1

name: Ghost Step 1
description: Vaults over the target directly in front of you, and sends you 5 tiles away.  Works on monsters or aislings.  Deals 0 damage, and will not break hide.  Pure only.

name: Hunter's Mark 1

name: Killing Shot 1
description: Execution shot that instantly kills an enemy at or below 20% hp, up to 7 tiles away.  Bosses and aislings will never be executed right away.

name: Sidestep 1
description: Vaults over the enemy directly in front of you, and jumps another 3 tiles away.  Deals no damage and will not break hide.

name: Siphoning Shot 1
description: Drains 10% of the mana from your target within 7 tiles, restoring up to 20% of the mana to you and your group within 15 tiles.  Deals damage equal to the mana stolen.

name: Snipe 1
description: First at the first enemy within 7 tiles in front of you, dealing massive damage, and 3x as much against monsters.  Damage is further increased if you are not on the threat list already, and even more while used while hidden.  Has a 30% chance to instantly kill, if you were not the last one to hit it.  Scales with DEX and max health/mana.

name: Splitting Shot 1
description: An arrow that splits in front of you, for up to 7 tiles or until it hits a target.  Applies Armor Break.

name: Steady Aim 1
description: Adds up to 25% extra damage based on your distance from the target.  +15% at range 2 or 7; +20% at range 3 or 6; +25% at range 4 or 5; and no bonus at ranges 1 or 8+.  Applies to skills and spells (excluding damage that ignores armor).

name: Triple Shot 1
description: Quickly shoots 3 arrows at your target, up to 7 tiles away, each dealing medium damage.  You will be locked in place for 2s while you shoot.

name: Warning Shot 1
description: Shoot at a target up to 7 tiles away, pushing them back 2 tiles.

name: Assassin Strike 1
description: Strikes the enemy in front of you for massive damage, increased further if you used true hide.  30% chance to instantly kill a normal monster that is not wary of you.  Damage scales with your vitality and DEX.

name: Engage 1
description: Charge forward 2 tiles.  Deals no damage, and does not break hide.

name: Eviscerate 1
description: Vicious finisher that deals massive damage.

name: First Blood 1
description: Attacks every enemy in a row for 3 tiles in front of you.

name: Initiative 1
description: Charge forward 3 tiles.  Deals no damage and does not break hide.  Pure Only.

name: Killer's Edge 1
description: Increases Advantage's bonus from from the side or behind by an addictional 15%.

name: Last Breath 1
description: Instantly kills normal monsters below 20% health.  Deals an additional 3% for every rank of malice you hold, up to 35% at a full bar.  Successful execute keeps your malice, but if it does not execute, will spend it all.  Successful execute will halve the cooldown.  Anything that survives will take damage based on your DEX and 4.3% of your max health.

name: Puncture 1
description: Thrust into the enemy directly in front of you dealing tremendous damage and applying Armor Break.

name: Rupture 1

name: Shadow Slip 1

name: Cadence 1

name: Crescendo 1
description: Spends harmony built by your current song to heal you and your group within 6 tiles.  Your current song then adds it's own burst; - Mending: Shields, - March: rallies on top of its own bonus for 8s, - Bulwark: Lifts every affliction it knows, - Dirge: Wails at nearby enemies.  The heal and burst scales with harmony spent (except Bulwark).

name: Mind Hymn 1
description: Siphons 15% of the targets max mana (of what they have left).  Mana beyond your maximum is lost, and a target with 0 mana will give nothing.

name: Bloodbath 1

name: Carnage 1

name: Bajiquan 1

name: Hu Bu

name: Thornlash 1

name: Thornwrath 1
description: Thorns tear outward in a wider ring than Bramblestorm, pulling every enemy within 7 tiles to your side.  Everything is taunted, and taunt reapplies every second for 5s.  Damage and threat both scales with CON.  Pure only.

name: Verdant Palm 1

name: Warden's Burden
description: Steals threat from member of your group within 8 tiles.  Every enemy within 12 tiles set on them, is taunted by you (provoked further based on your CON).  Needs a group member near by.

name: Attune Earth 1
description: Turns your magic to Earth.  Every elemental spell becomes its earth counter-part, and starts on a 5s cooldown.  5 stages based on how long you hold it (0s, 45s, 105s, 210s, 360s), raising your spell damage by 5% to 30%, flat spell damage from 40 to 400.  Attuning again is free, and ends when you die.

name: Attune Fire 1
